summary: A cleaned, downloadable CSV of WBENC-certified women-owned businesses sourced from the public buywomenowned.com directory and WBENCLink 2.0 platform. WBENC certifies over 18,000 women-owned businesses across the US, and more than 500 corporations (mostly Fortune 500) actively use WBENC certification as a core part of their supplier diversity programs. The buywomenowned.com directory is publicly searchable, and WBENCLink 2.0 connects women-owned suppliers with corporate procurement teams. Supplier diversity consulting firms and matchmaking platforms (like SupplierDiversity.com, All Aces Promotional) serve this market, demonstrating B2B demand. A one-time CSV ($49-$69) of all WBENC-certified businesses with industry classification, certification date, and contact details targets corporate supplier diversity managers, procurement consultants, and B2B matchmaking platforms looking to onboard certified women-owned suppliers.

audience.who: Corporate supplier diversity and procurement managers at Fortune 500 companies running WBENC supplier onboarding programs; supplier diversity consulting firms (SupplierDiversity.com, National Minority Supplier Development Council) helping clients build diverse vendor rosters; B2B matchmaking platforms connecting certified suppliers with corporate buyers; state and local government procurement offices with women-owned business set-aside programs; and business development consultants targeting WBENC-certified businesses for growth services (financing, marketing, operations consulting).

data_wanted: Business name, owner name(s), WBENC certification number, certification date, industry/NAICS code, business address (street, city, state, ZIP), phone number, website, email (where publicly listed), certification status (active), product/service category — sourced from buywomenowned.com public directory and WBENCLink 2.0 accessible profiles, all publicly searchable data.

evidence.source: WBENC certification overview — 18,000+ certified businesses and 500+ corporate members (mostly Fortune 500) actively using the program
evidence.quote: More than 18,000 businesses hold WBENC certification, and more than 500 corporations — most of them Fortune 500 — use it as a core part of their supplier diversity programs

evidence.source: Buy Women Owned directory — public searchable database of certified women-owned suppliers where corporate buyers discover vendors
evidence.quote: Certified businesses get listed on buywomenowned.com. This searchable directory serves as the primary platform where corporations and procurement teams can identify and connect with certified women-owned suppliers

evidence.source: WBENCLink 2.0 platform — digitized certification database connecting 16,000+ WBEs and 350 corporate members
evidence.quote: WBENCLink 2.0 is a fully digitized certification tool and database connecting women-owned businesses and corporate and government members across the country, providing access to over 16,000 WBEs and 350 corporate members

evidence.source: Center for Women & Enterprise — WBENC certification resource emphasizing corporate supplier diversity demand
evidence.quote: The Women's Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC) is the largest third-party certifier of women-owned businesses in the United States

willingness_to_pay.signal: Fortune 500 companies have multi-million-dollar supplier diversity budgets and procurement teams dedicated to sourcing WBENC-certified vendors. A corporate supplier diversity manager at a company like Walmart or Bank of America would pay $49-$69 for a complete CSV of all 18,000 WBENC-certified businesses filtered by industry to accelerate vendor discovery for a new category (e.g., all WBENC IT services firms for a tech RFP). Supplier diversity consultants billing $150-$300/hour would buy this list to support client engagements. B2B matchmaking platforms would pay for enriched data to onboard certified suppliers at scale.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + LinkedIn targeting Fortune 500 supplier diversity managers and procurement consultants, Reddit r/procurement and r/smallbusiness (for certified WBE angle), LinkedIn groups for supplier diversity professionals (National Minority Supplier Development Council community, Women's Business Enterprise Council groups), direct outreach to supplier diversity consulting firms
first_sale_path.angle: "WBENC-Certified Women-Owned Businesses 2026 — 18,000+ Businesses, CSV" — business name, owner, certification #, industry/NAICS, address, phone, website, certification date. Angle for corporate procurement: 'Every business on this list is WBENC-certified and ready for supplier diversity programs. Filter by industry, state, or NAICS code to find vendors for your next RFP.' Emphasize public data, compliance-ready supplier discovery, and time savings vs. manual directory searches. Launch national list first, then consider state-specific or industry-vertical SKUs (e.g., 'WBENC IT Services Firms' or 'WBENC California Manufacturers').
